content:
Feed Seedance 2.5 three reference images plus a single prompt to lock character and style consistency across an entire shot.  
Use Seedance 2.5 to generate a single continuous 30-second tracking shot (no cuts) to maintain continuity over longer takes.  
Use timestamp-based editing by selecting the exact second on the timeline you want changed so only that moment is adjusted while the rest of the shot remains unchanged.
